usedFor: Shopify raises store events like “Order Cancelled”, and eSignatures receives contract changes through “Create Contract” and “Withdraw Contract”.

bestTemplate.name: “Order Cancelled” in Shopify, then “Withdraw Contract” in eSignatures
bestTemplate.why: A cancelled order should not stay open for signing, so the action withdraws the contract.

watchOut: “Withdraw Contract” in eSignatures stops a contract being signed, so check which contract it targets.
